name: Birdsville Courthouse
scope: The surviving principal courthouse building, comprising the original courtroom and attached residence with their verandahs and later enclosed timber and corrugated sections. The separately located tracker’s hut and lockup are distinct precinct buildings.
era: Standing courthouse with its protected original fabric and later residential alterations.

originalReview.notes: The unmodified 1925 State Library archive photo shows corrugated roofs, the transverse gable, verandah posts, sandstone blockwork and a chimney. It informs only persistent fabric; later enclosure and finish use written condition records.

review.notes: Started with the published Qualla gallery. The named 1925 photo is byte-identical to the State Library’s Commons original, identifies the archive accession and photographer and carries the public-domain designation. The camel, hotel and racecourse photographs did not inform the model.
